\section{Statistical tests}
Table~\ref{tab:significance} lists the paired bootstrap tests behind the comparisons in the main paper. For each image we average \Sa{} over the conditions of a group, take the difference between two models on the same images, and resample these differences 5{,}000 times. A difference is called significant when its 95\% interval excludes zero. Ours (512) is tested with its first seed; its three seeds differ by at most \NOursFiveCodMcorrStd{} in mean \Sa{} under corruption on COD10K.
